item.title: Whiskers 0.8.34
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.34

### Bulk Transcription

  • Redesigned the Bulk Transcription page with a clearer import flow and more detailed file cards
  • Added a bulk-only AI enhancement model override so you can choose a different enhancement model for bulk runs without changing your global setting

    • ### Improvements

  • Added clearer in-app feedback when recording cannot start due to permissions, model readiness, or audio issues
  • Improved hotkey startup reliability after launch and after granting Accessibility permission
  • Improved the recording start cue when using Bluetooth output so it is more consistently audible
  • Simplified model names in the model picker to reduce clutter

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where downloading a model could unexpectedly change your currently selected model
